title: Select Streamline input mode in Stage 1
summary: Fifth Stage 1 mode card 'streamline' always rendered; selecting swaps the file area for StreamlineDropZone + image grid + review screen and hides the normal Continue button. No feature flag.
notes: Mode selection is not persisted until commit (useStageState autoSave:false). Mode buttons stay clickable even when Stage 1 is locked.

title: Drop/choose documents: server extraction + classification per file
summary: Each accepted file (.txt/.md/.pdf/.docx/.rtf, <=20MB, <=10 files) is POSTed individually to /streamline/extract-file, which extracts text (pdf-parse/mammoth/rtf-to-text/utf8) and classifies it (deterministic script detection, else LLM). Failures are isolated per file.
notes: Legacy .doc rejected client-side and server-side. Response held only in React state.
preconditions: projectId owned by the user (route 404 otherwise; 'new' 404s)
code_path: processFiles -> extractOne -> streamlineService.extractFile -> POST extract-file -> extractText -> classifyFile -> (extractStandaloneAssetDraft)

title: Paste text as a file
summary: Pasted text becomes a StreamlineFile with status success and classification unclassified/0. It is never sent to the server for classification and never triggers Ask Auteur on its own.
notes: The user must override the type for it to route; the routing blocks with 'couldn't identify anything usable' otherwise.

title: Override a file's type
summary: A per-file select sets typeOverride (script/treatment/beat_sheet/character_notes/unclassified), which wins over the server classification in effectiveType(). An explicit 'script' override bypasses the client confidence check in routing.
notes: Overriding to character_notes yields no asset draft (drafts are produced only server-side at extract time). Overriding to script on a low-confidence file locks Stage 4 but skips scene persistence.

title: Set primary file / remove file
summary: The star button sets isPrimary (the first file defaults to primary; removing the primary re-assigns it to the first remaining file). isPrimary only adds a '(PRIMARY)' tag in the Ask Auteur prompt; routing ignores it.
evidence: StreamlineDropZone.test.tsx 'primary-file selection persists in session state'
notes: The four-tier authority util (resolveConflict) that would use isPrimary is orphaned.

title: Retry failed file extraction
summary: The Retry button on an errored file shows only the toast 'Re-select the file to retry'. No request is made.
notes: The original File bytes are not retained.
entrypoint: RefreshCw icon on an errored row

title: Per-file As-is / AI-format choice
summary: For treatment/beat_sheet files, clicking AI-format calls /streamline/format-file once and stores formattedText/formattedBeats. The default formatChoice is 'ai-format' when confidence < 0.75, but formatting is not auto-run. Routing ignores formatChoice and always prefers the formatted output if any.
evidence: streamlineRouting.test.ts 'uses the AI-formatted text over the raw text when present'
notes: Persisted only as the committed Stage 2/3 content. Choosing As-is after formatting still commits the formatted text.
preconditions: effective type treatment or beat_sheet; file has text
code_path: setFormatChoice -> runAiFormat -> streamlineService.formatFile -> POST format-file -> formatAsTreatment|formatAsBeatSheet

title: Standalone Stage 5 asset draft from character/location notes
summary: When the server classifies a file as character_notes, extract-file makes one more LLM call to prefill {name,type,description}. The draft shows as a badge and is committed as a project_assets row with source 'extracted'.
notes: Not re-derived after reconciliation. Not produced for user-overridden character_notes. Draft fields are not editable in the UI before commit. The review line counts all notes files even when some lack drafts.

title: Batch reference image upload + AI classification
summary: Images (PNG/JPEG/WebP <=10MB, max 20) are each uploaded to the storage bucket asset-images at project/{id}/streamline-staging/ and classified by Gemini Vision into {name,type,description}. The guessed name is fuzzy-matched to known note-draft names. Cards default to accepted.
notes: Storage object persisted immediately and never deleted, even if the card is removed or the commit never happens. A classification failure returns the fallback 'Unnamed subject'/character/conf 0.

title: Edit/accept/skip/remove image cards
summary: Name, type and description are freely editable per card; the accept toggle controls inclusion in routing; X removes the card (but not the stored file).
notes: Heavyweight image actions (edit/style/bg) are intentionally absent; they exist only in EnhancedUploadModal after the asset exists.

title: Ask Auteur automatic clarification analysis
summary: When every in-flight file extraction settles, Stage 1 calls /streamline/analyze once per component mount with all successful files' text. The returned multiple-choice questions replace the review screen until they are answered or declined.
notes: Runs only once (askAuteurRequestedRef). Not triggered for paste-only batches. Analysis errors are silent. Commit is not blocked while analysis is in flight.
preconditions: projectId!=='new'; >=1 success file with text; ref not yet set
code_path: onBatchSettled -> runAskAuteurAnalysis -> streamlineService.analyze -> POST analyze -> analyzeBatch

title: Answer Ask Auteur questions and reconcile documents
summary: The user picks an option or types a freetext answer for every question. Submit builds resolutions (client_id r{i}) and calls /streamline/reconcile, which returns full revised document texts with editScope. Non-cascade edits are applied to in-memory file text immediately; structural_cascade edits wait for the confirmation dialog.
notes: Resolutions and edits persist only at commit. All edits are attributed to r0. Stale formattedText defeats the reconciled edits. Stage1 handler untested.
code_path: handleSubmit -> handleAskAuteurSubmit -> streamlineService.reconcile -> POST reconcile -> reconcileDocuments

title: Decline Ask Auteur questions
summary: 'Skip these questions' records every question as a resolution with selected_answer null and answer_source ai_inferred, with no reconcile call.
notes: Declined rows later inject question_text as an 'ESTABLISHED FACT' wherever facts are injected.

title: Structural cascade confirmation dialog
summary: Reconciled documents classified structural_cascade by the LLM are shown in a dialog listing file plus diffSummary. Apply writes the LLM full-text rewrite into in-memory file text; Cancel keeps the original text and drops those files' resolution_edits. Commit is blocked while it is pending.
notes: Only scope-gated: word_patch/paragraph_rewrite also replace full text but silently. The scope label is the LLM's self-assessment.

title: Pre-commit review screen with routing preview
summary: Shows successful files with confidence, a failed-file notice, 'What happens next' lines from computeStreamlineRouting, a fixed-text credit estimate, the Ask Auteur edit summaries, and the blocked reason. The button is 'Confirm & Skip Ahead'.
notes: Credit estimate is a static string; no computed cost.
entrypoint: rendered when files/images exist and no open questions

title: Confirm & Skip Ahead atomic commit
summary: Sends stageTransitions + projectConfig + stage1Draft + assets + resolutions + resolutionEdits to /streamline/commit, which calls the RPC streamline_commit_atomic. One transaction updates projects config, inserts a Stage 1 draft, applies the lock/skip transitions for stages 1-4, and inserts project_assets, intake_resolutions and intake_resolution_edits.
notes: FUNCTIONAL=U: SQL never tested and live migration state unknown. Route tests mock the RPC.
preconditions: canConfirm; projectId!=='new'; no open questions; no pending cascade
code_path: handleStreamlineCommit -> streamlineService.commit -> POST commit -> rpc streamline_commit_atomic -> streamline_commit

title: Post-commit scene persistence from imported script
summary: After the RPC succeeds, if a script file passes FE confidence (!='low'), the frontend extracts scenes and calls PUT /api/projects/:id/scenes with the tiptapDoc for deterministic dependency extraction. Zero scenes throws an error after the commit has already landed.
notes: Not atomic with the RPC. Not executed for override-to-script low-confidence files. PUT /scenes hard-deletes scenes absent from the new extraction.
preconditions: script file with FE confidence != low

title: Land on first unfilled stage after commit
summary: targetStage = 5 if transitions exist for stages 1-4, else the first of 2,3,4 without a transition. ProjectView re-fetches stage_states, re-derives statuses (skipped counts as passed), sets the target active, and navigates.
notes: The current stage is persisted via setCurrentStageWithPersistence (localStorage key, cross-slice).

title: Skipped stage placeholder
summary: When a Phase-A stage's latest status is skipped, ProjectView renders SkippedStagePlaceholder (SKIPPED badge, 'Generate this now' for stages 2/3, 'Write this myself' for all) instead of the stage editor.
notes: The stage 4 variant is reachable only if a stage-4 skipped row exists (routing never emits it).

title: Generate skipped Stage 2/3 from locked script (backfill)
summary: 'Generate this now' POSTs /streamline/backfill/:n. The route requires the latest row to be skipped and Stage 4 locked with formattedScript, generates a treatment or beats via LLM, and inserts a new stage_states row status locked, origin ai-generated.
notes: Locks directly without a draft review. Fails with SCRIPT_NOT_LOCKED for beat-sheet-only imports. Tests cover only validation paths.
preconditions: stage 2 or 3 skipped; stage 4 locked with non-empty formattedScript
code_path: handleGenerateFromScript -> backfillStage -> POST backfill -> backfillTreatment|backfillBeatSheet -> insert stage_states

title: Write skipped stage myself (unskip)
summary: 'Write this myself' calls the generic unlock route with confirm=true, which inserts a draft with content {} and marks downstream locked/outdated Phase-A stages outdated. The UI updates only the unskipped stage locally.
notes: Unskipping Stage 2 after a script import marks the imported Stage 4 outdated server-side, but the timeline still shows it locked until reload.

title: Stage provenance badges (SKIPPED / IMPORTED / AUTO-FILLED)
summary: PhaseTimeline shows badges from getStageBadge(status, origin): skipped -> SKIPPED; locked+imported -> IMPORTED; locked+ai-generated -> AUTO-FILLED with a 'won't update automatically' tooltip; outdated -> OUTDATED.
notes: The origin subtext on OUTDATED is unreachable because no writer sets origin on outdated rows.

title: Ask Auteur 'ESTABLISHED FACTS' injection into later prompts
summary: ContextManager.assembleGlobalContext loads intake_resolutions per branch; formatAuteurResolutions renders 'ESTABLISHED FACTS (do not contradict)'. In production only backfillTreatment injects it, and only when a writing style capsule is present; the Stage 2/3/4 context formatters that include it have no production caller.
notes: generate-from-template (used by forward Stage 2-4 generation) does not inject resolutions.
preconditions: intake_resolutions rows on the branch; writing style capsule resolved

title: Skip a Phase-A stage via REST
summary: POST /api/projects/:id/stages/:n/skip inserts a skipped row (content {}, origin skipped) for n in {2,3,4} if the previous stage is locked or skipped and the current stage is not locked. The frontend method stageStateService.skipStage has no caller.
notes: Reachable only by raw HTTP.

title: EnhancedUploadModal image reconciliation (Stage 5 & Stage 8)
summary: After a manual asset image upload plus analyze-image, a dialog shows current/extracted/final descriptions with a confidence badge and offers Edit Image, Apply Style, Remove BG (not for location) and Regenerate (optional ref) via startEditImageJob plus 2s polling (max 90). It keeps an in-memory image history carousel. Accept saves the final description and selects the matching attempt.
notes: Presentational; job/persistence logic belongs to the Stage 5/8 slices. Cancel stops polling but not the server job. Not used by Streamline.
entrypoint: asset image upload in Stage 5 or Stage 8

title: FileStagingArea client-side file staging (non-streamline modes)
summary: Expansion (optional), Condensation, Transformation and Script Skip modes stage files with FileReader.readAsText; PDF content is stored as ''; primary file and tag selection; stored in Stage 1 content.uploadedFiles.
notes: No server extraction, unlike Streamline. .doc/.docx read as text (binary garbage) and PDF yields empty content. V3 owns downstream use.

title: Streamline prose document classification
summary: One LLM call per non-script document classifies it as treatment/beat_sheet/character_notes/unclassified with a confidence value.
notes: Skipped entirely when the regex script detector returns high/ambiguous.
provider: Google Gemini via llmClient (LangChain, LangSmith tracing optional)
user_prompt_src: inline: FILENAME + first 6000 chars of text (L39)
output_parse: extractJsonObject; invalid type -> unclassified; confidence clamped, default 0.5
retry_fallback: llmClient retries (3, exp backoff); any error -> {unclassified,0}

title: Standalone asset draft from note file
summary: Prefills a single {name,type,description} Stage 5 asset draft from a character_notes document.
notes: temp 0.3, maxTokens 500
output_parse: extractJsonObject; invalid type -> character; missing name -> filename sans ext
retry_fallback: llmClient retries; throw caught by route as non-fatal (draft omitted)

title: AI-format document as treatment
summary: Reformats loose text into a 2-4 paragraph prose treatment, instructed not to invent content.
notes: temp 0.5, maxTokens 2048; full text untruncated

title: AI-format document as beat sheet
summary: Reformats loose text into a JSON beat array grounded in the source.
notes: temp 0.4, maxTokens 4096
output_parse: extractJsonArray (fence strip, trailing comma, truncation, regex object repair); uuid ids; runtime summed

title: Ask Auteur question generation
summary: One call over the whole batch finds contradictions, vague traits, ambiguous structure and missing info, and returns 2-4 option multiple-choice questions with optional subject entity and conflicting sources.
notes: temp 0.3, maxTokens 2048
user_prompt_src: buildUserPrompt() L73-L77: per file header with (PRIMARY) + first 4000 chars
context_inputs: all successful files' text, names, isPrimary
output_parse: extractJsonArray; filter valid categories; ids q-{i}-{Date.now()}; options normalized

title: Ask Auteur reconciliation (rewrite documents from answers)
summary: Given all documents and the Q&A transcript, returns, for changed documents only, the full revised text, editScope (word_patch/paragraph_rewrite/structural_cascade) and a one-line diffSummary.
notes: temp 0.2, maxTokens 8192; documents sent untruncated (large batches may exceed output budget: UNKNOWN)
output_parse: extractJsonArray; match by fileName; invalid scope -> paragraph_rewrite; default summary
retry_fallback: empty inputs short-circuit; llmClient retries; errors propagate -> 500
persistence: rewritten text -> committed stage content; intake_resolution_edits rows

title: Backfill treatment from locked script
summary: Writes a 2-4 paragraph treatment summarizing the locked Stage 4 screenplay, with project genre, rating, length and (only when a writing style capsule exists) style + ESTABLISHED FACTS injection.
notes: temp 0.5, maxTokens 2048. No test exercises the LLM path.
context_inputs: stage 4 formattedScript, projectParams (genres, contentRating, target lengths), formatForInjection(writing style, auteur resolutions) if writingStyleCapsule
output_parse: trim -> single variation, structuralEmphasis balanced, runtime midpoint

title: Backfill beat sheet from locked script
summary: Extracts major structural beats from the locked Stage 4 screenplay as a JSON array.
notes: temp 0.4, maxTokens 4096. No style or facts injection.

title: Streamline reference image classification (vision)
summary: Gemini Vision guesses {name,type,description,confidence} for an uploaded image buffer.
notes: Bypasses llmClient (no retry, no LangSmith).
output_parse: regex first {...} + JSON.parse; invalid type -> character; confidence clamped, default 0.5
retry_fallback: none in service; route catches any error -> 'Unnamed subject'/character/conf 0
persistence: project_assets name/type/description/image_key_url on commit if accepted

title: POST /api/projects/:projectId/streamline/commit
summary: Validates stageTransitions object, checks project ownership, forwards payload to rpc('streamline_commit_atomic'); RPC error -> 400 with message; else returns the RPC JSON.
notes: Mounted with authenticateUser at /api/projects.

title: POST /api/projects/:projectId/streamline/backfill/:stageNumber
summary: Stages 2/3 only; latest row must be skipped; generates via backfill service; inserts a locked ai-generated row (version+1, inherited_from_stage_id = skipped row); bumps projects.updated_at.
notes: Locked insert is also subject to the 044 trigger.

title: POST /api/projects/:projectId/streamline/extract-file
summary: multer memory 20MB single 'file'; extractText -> classifyFile -> optional standalone asset draft; returns {filename,text,classification,assetDraft?}; UnsupportedFileTypeError -> 400; else 500.

title: POST /api/projects/:projectId/streamline/classify-image
summary: multer 10MB PNG/JPEG/WebP; uploads to storage asset-images/project/{id}/streamline-staging/; classifies via Gemini Vision with a fallback guess; returns {imageUrl,filename,classification}.
notes: Storage write happens before classification and is never cleaned up.

title: POST /api/projects/:projectId/streamline/format-file
summary: Body {text,targetType in treatment|beat_sheet}; returns {targetType,treatment} or {targetType,beats,totalEstimatedRuntime}.

title: POST /api/projects/:projectId/streamline/analyze
summary: Body {files[]} non-empty; returns {questions} (always 200 with [] when nothing to ask or on service error).

title: POST /api/projects/:projectId/streamline/reconcile
summary: Body {files[] non-empty, qaPairs[]}; returns {reconciledDocuments}; empty qaPairs short-circuits to [].

title: POST /api/projects/:projectId/stages/:stageNumber/skip
summary: Generic skip route (stages 2-4) added for Streamline Phase 1; no frontend caller.
notes: Owned jointly with the Phase-A stage-state slice.

title: stage_states: 'skipped' status + origin provenance column
summary: Migration 041 widens the status CHECK to include 'skipped' and adds a nullable origin column constrained to skipped/imported/ai-generated/authored, with a partial index.
notes: origin is written by the RPC, the backfill route, the skip route and the generic PUT; it is not copied by the lock/unlock routes.

title: project_assets.source gains 'streamline_import'
summary: Migration 042 widens the source CHECK to extracted/manual/cloned/streamline_import. The commit RPC inserts image cards as streamline_import and note drafts as extracted, with locked=false and empty scene_numbers.
notes: No frontend code branches on source==='streamline_import' (grep).

title: intake_resolutions (Ask Auteur facts ledger)
summary: Per-branch rows: question_text, question_category (contradiction|vague_trait|ambiguous_structure|missing_info|conflict_resolution), options jsonb, selected_answer, answer_source (option|freetext|ai_inferred), subject entity type/name, conflicting_sources, created_by. RLS policies by branch->project owner. Written only by the commit RPC; read only by ContextManager.fetchAuteurResolutions.
notes: conflict_resolution never produced. No UI ever displays stored resolutions.

title: intake_resolution_edits (reconciliation audit trail)
summary: Rows referencing intake_resolutions (cascade delete): target_type stage|asset, target_stage_number, target_asset_name, edit_scope, diff_summary. Inserted by the RPC via the client_id map. Never read by any code.
notes: FE always sends target_type 'stage', target_stage_number null, resolution r0. Write-only table (grep found no reads).

title: RPC streamline_commit / streamline_commit_atomic + trigger trg_streamline_stage_lock_prerequisite
summary: streamline_commit (041, replaced by 042 and then 043) applies stage transitions, assets, resolutions and edits. streamline_commit_atomic (044) adds the project_config update and Stage 1 draft insert, then delegates. 044 also installs a BEFORE INSERT trigger on stage_states that blocks a locked insert at stage n>1 unless stage n-1 is locked or skipped.
notes: Not SECURITY DEFINER; called with the service role. EXECUTE grants for client roles are not addressed: UNKNOWN.

title: Phase-A stage transitions applied by the Streamline commit
summary: Per stage key in ascending order: 'skip' -> new row skipped/origin skipped/content {}; 'locked' -> copy the latest content as locked (origin kept or 'authored'); object -> new row with the given status/content/origin. Each is version+1 and append-only.
notes: Routing emits only: 1 'locked'; 2/3 skip or locked-imported; 4 locked-imported. Never stage 5.
precondition: stages in 1..5; skip only 2-4; skip not over locked; lock/skip needs prev locked|skipped
invalidates: nothing (no outdated marking of later stages or Phase B)
preserves: older versions remain as history rows
ui_signal: PhaseTimeline badges SKIPPED/IMPORTED; navigation to target stage

title: Stage 1 double-version write on commit
summary: streamline_commit_atomic inserts a Stage 1 draft (content = full Stage 1 form state, origin authored); the '1':'locked' transition then inserts a locked copy. Every commit adds two Stage 1 versions, even when Stage 1 was already locked.
evidence: streamlineCommit.test.ts 'forwards project configuration and the Stage 1 draft'
notes: Stage 1 content has no processedInput (unlike the normal handleComplete path).
side_effects: projects config columns updated from projectConfig (COALESCE)
ui_signal: Stage 1 shows locked header after navigation back

title: Transient intake session state
summary: Files (text, classification, overrides, format results, drafts), image cards, questions, pending cascade, edit summaries and resolutions are all React useState in Stage1InputMode, plus askAuteurRequestedRef. Nothing is persisted before commit except staged image files in storage.
notes: Unmount (stage navigation, reload) discards everything; storage objects are orphaned.
persistence: React memory; Supabase storage for images

title: Backfill: skipped -> locked (ai-generated)
summary: The backfill route inserts version+1 status locked origin ai-generated with LLM content, inherited_from_stage_id = the skipped row id.
precondition: latest status skipped; stage 4 locked with formattedScript; trigger prerequisite (prev locked|skipped)
side_effects: projects.updated_at; local stage status set locked/ai-generated

title: Unskip: skipped -> draft via unlock
summary: Unlock with confirm=true accepts a skipped row, inserts a draft with content {} (origin not set), and cascades 'outdated' rows to downstream Phase-A stages whose latest status is locked or outdated.
preserves: skipped rows (skipped downstream stages not touched)
ui_signal: only the target stage set active locally; downstream outdated not shown until reload

title: Ask Auteur session lifecycle
summary: idle -> analyzing (on first batch settle) -> questions shown (blocks confirm) -> submit (reconciling) -> [pendingCascade dialog] -> review; or decline -> review. Opens at most once per mount.
notes: isAnalyzing does not block confirm; a reconcile error keeps the questions open.
side_effects: resolutions/edits staged for commit; file.text rewritten
ui_signal: 'Checking your material…' text; question cards; cascade dialog; edit summaries list

title: Global DB trigger: locked stage n>1 requires stage n-1 locked or skipped
summary: BEFORE INSERT trigger on stage_states raises for any locked insert at stage_number>1 unless the latest stage n-1 row is locked or skipped, regardless of the writer.
notes: Applies to all stage_states writers (cross-slice). The same rule exists in the Node lock route and the RPC.
trigger: any INSERT into stage_states with status locked
side_effects: raises exception (rolls back the enclosing tx)

title: Skip guards
summary: Only stages 2, 3, 4 may be skipped; cannot skip a stage whose latest row is locked; the previous stage must be locked or skipped. Enforced in the RPC and in the REST skip route.
notes: A commit with a script on a project whose Stage 2 or 3 is already locked but has no matching file fails as a whole.

title: Content-bearing commit supersedes existing locked content; no downstream invalidation
summary: Object transitions insert new locked versions for stages 2-4 without checking for existing locked content, and the RPC never marks later stages (5, Phase B) outdated.
notes: Contrast: the unlock route cascades outdated.
preserves: older versions; Stage 5+ untouched (stale relative to new content)

title: Post-commit scene sync deletes scenes removed from the script
summary: PUT /scenes (called after the RPC) matches existing scenes by slug+number or number, updates them, inserts new ones and hard-deletes unmatched existing scenes.
notes: Owned by the scenes slice; listed because Streamline triggers it. Line range for the delete is approximate (~1419-1440).
trigger: commit with a usable script (FE confidence != low)
side_effects: scenes inserts/updates/deletes; dependency columns from extractManifest
invalidates: deleted scenes (and dependent rows: UNKNOWN cascade)

title: Unskip cascades outdated to downstream stages
summary: 'Write this myself' reuses unlock(confirm=true), so un-skipping Stage 2 or 3 marks a locked imported Stage 4 (and Stage 5 if locked) outdated.
notes: The code comment claims there is 'no real content to lose' and skips the impact dialog; downstream content is still marked outdated.

title: origin provenance dropped on lock/unlock
summary: The Node lock route and the unlock route insert rows without copying origin, so IMPORTED/AUTO-FILLED badges disappear after any unlock->relock cycle and outdated rows never carry origin.
trigger: lock or unlock via stageStates routes

title: Atomicity boundary and retry duplication
summary: The RPC is all-or-nothing, but scene persistence runs afterwards. If it fails, the user stays on Stage 1 with intake state intact, and pressing Confirm again re-runs the whole RPC, inserting more Stage 1-4 versions plus duplicate project_assets and intake_resolutions.
notes: No idempotency key; no dedupe.

title: Cascade cancel drops audit edits; reconcile failure keeps questions open
summary: Cancelling the structural cascade removes resolution_edits for those fileIds while the resolutions remain. A reconcile error leaves the questions displayed, which blocks commit until resubmit or decline.
notes: resolutionsForCommit is set before reconcile is called, so resolutions survive a reconcile failure.

title: Text extraction libraries
summary: PDF via pdf-parse v2 PDFParse.getText; DOCX via mammoth.extractRawText; RTF via rtf-to-text stripRtf on a utf-8 decode; TXT/MD utf-8; .doc and others throw UnsupportedFileTypeError. Dispatch by MIME or extension.
notes: No OCR; scanned PDFs yield little or no text (UNKNOWN in practice).

title: Script detection is duplicated FE/BE with different parsers
summary: Backend classification uses a regex line scanner (INT./EXT. headings, uppercase character lines, then dialogue); frontend routing and Stage 4 content use parseScriptToTiptapJson node counts. Both use thresholds 3/1. Backend script confidence is 0.95 (high) or <=0.75 (ambiguous).
notes: A file classified 'script' by the backend can fail the FE check and silently not route as a script (test 'a script that fails client-side confidence').

title: Routing matrix and target stage
summary: Script -> 1 lock, 2/3 imported-or-skip, 4 imported, land on 5. Beat sheet (no script) -> 2 imported-or-skip, 3 imported, land on 4. Treatment only -> 2 imported, land on 3. Notes/images only -> only 1 locked, land on 2. The first file of each type wins; extras are ignored silently.
notes: Imported Stage 4 content: {formattedScript, tiptapDoc, scenes:[], syncStatus:'synced'}.

title: No feature flag gates Streamline
summary: The mode card is unconditional; the only config is the two detector thresholds. Behavioral gates: projectId!=='new', projectConfigReady (type + tonal >=10 chars), no open questions or pending cascade.
notes: isAnalyzing is not a gate.

title: formatChoice has no effect on committed content
summary: buildTreatmentContent uses formattedText ?? text and buildBeatSheetContent uses formattedBeats if present, regardless of formatChoice. The default 'ai-format' for confidence < 0.75 never triggers formatting by itself.

title: Reconciliation edits attribution is approximate
summary: Every resolution_edit is linked to resolution client_id r0 with target_type 'stage', target_asset_name null and no target_stage_number, even for character-notes files.
notes: Acknowledged in a code comment.

title: Reconciled text not propagated to formatted output or asset drafts
summary: applyReconciledDocuments rewrites only file.text, so previously AI-formatted treatment/beats and server-generated assetDrafts keep the pre-answer content and are what gets committed.

title: Override-to-script low-confidence file: Stage 4 locked but no scenes
summary: Routing honors typeOverride==='script' (isUsableScript), but the post-commit scene persistence filter requires detectScriptConfidence != 'low' with no override clause, so scenes are silently not persisted and the user lands on Stage 5.

title: Declined questions become 'established facts' text
summary: formatAuteurResolutions emits selected_answer ?? question_text, so ai_inferred rows with a null answer inject the raw question as a fact under 'ESTABLISHED FACTS (do not contradict)'.
notes: Only reaches the backfill-treatment prompt in production.

title: Ask Auteur trigger coverage gaps
summary: Analysis fires only on a transition from in-flight extraction to settled, once per mount (ref). Paste-only batches, files added after the first settle, and image-only batches never get questions. The commit can proceed while analysis is still running.

title: Writing style capsule and processedInput absent for Streamline projects
summary: projectConfig omits writing_style_capsule_id and no processedInput is written. ContextManager and Stage 3/4 read the capsule from projects.writing_style_capsule_id or processedInput, so a Stage 1 capsule selection is not consumed. Stage 2 generation throws without processedInput, and Stage 3 generation uses hard-coded fallback params (180-300s, Drama, 'Emotional and contemplative').
notes: Whether projects.writing_style_capsule_id is set by another path: UNKNOWN.

title: Commit asset payload omits style capsule and scene numbers
summary: Frontend asset entries carry name, asset_type, description, source and image_key_url only, so the RPC writes visual_style_capsule_id NULL, scene_numbers '{}' and locked false.
notes: image_key_url points at the streamline-staging path in storage.

title: LLM model resolution mismatch in llmClient
summary: llmClient's constructor default is gemini-2.5-flash-lite, but generate() falls back to gemini-1.5-flash when GEMINI_MODEL is unset; all streamline text calls go through generate() without a model override.
notes: Actual model depends on env (UNKNOWN).

title: No lock guard on Streamline when Stage 1 is locked
summary: Mode cards and the Streamline review/confirm UI render regardless of stageStatus; only the normal Continue button is hidden. A commit on a locked Stage 1 re-drafts and re-locks it.
notes: The RPC then fails only if a skip targets an already-locked stage.

title: Backend uses the service role; RPC ownership check is in Node only
summary: backend supabase client uses SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY; the commit route checks projects.user_id before calling the RPC, which itself trusts payload project_id/user_id.
evidence: streamlineCommit.test.ts 'returns 404 when the project is not owned'
notes: RLS policies on intake_* tables are therefore bypassed by the backend.

title: resolveConflict four-tier authority util
